name: Garden Souls
description:
About This Game

In Garden Souls, each run will offer you new ways to fight. Choose which strikes to unlock, empower your attacks with the six elemental forces, and try combinations that can create a unique combat style. Your choices will define how you face each challenge and make every attempt a completely different experience.

STYLISH COMBAT

Master a fast, technical combat system that rewards creativity. Combine ground and aerial attacks, cancel moves to extend combos, and keep enemies airborne until you find the perfect sequence.

  • Move freely with dash, double jump and wall jump.

  • Cancel attacks with dash, jump or spell to create bigger combos.

  • Break enemy defenses, launch them into walls and control the pace of battle.

CREATE UNIQUE BUILDS

Unlock new abilities during a run and experiment with different combinations to craft your own combat build.

  • Extra Strikes to expand your repertoire of attacks.

  • Elements that add unique effects to your strikes.

  • Spells that can completely change your strategy.

  • Bombogs, floral companions that fight automatically at your side.

  • Strikers, summoned allies who continue combos or turn the tide of battle.

  • Artifacts, upgrades that strengthen your build.

FOUR PRINCESSES

Each princess has unique strikes, animations, abilities and combos.

Rose: Fast attacks, high mobility and fluid combos.

Eris: Precision, pogo attacks and space control.

Solaris: Projectile specialist and field control.

Yuni: Slow, heavy and devastating strikes.

Choosing a new princess means learning a completely different way to fight.

DYNAMIC RUNS

Traverse procedurally generated areas while facing hordes of enemies, minibosses and bosses. Between fights, pick new abilities, visit shops, find special events and adapt your build to the run's challenges.

After each attempt, return to the Hub to unlock permanent upgrades, strengthen future runs and discover more about the world of Garden Souls.

FEATURES

  • Fast combat with ground and aerial combos.

  • Four characters with completely different playstyles.

  • Unlock new strikes during each run.

  • Combine elements to create new strategies.

  • Fight alongside Bombogs and summon Strikers in battle.

  • Permanent progression and high replayability.
short_desc: Garden Souls is a 2D action roguelite focused on fast combat, stylish combos and build crafting. Choose one of the four Garden Princesses, unlock new strikes, combine elements and adapt your combat style each run to face corrupted floral biomes and stop the Mandragora.
